def transform(grid):
    # A horizontal beam passes through the center of the outlined/stacked shape.
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    rmin, rmax = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    # Color the blank row separating the two parts of the pattern.
    occupied = sorted(set(r for r, c in cells))
    gaps = [r for r in range(rmin, rmax + 1) if r not in occupied]
    r = gaps[0] if gaps else (rmin + rmax) // 2
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    out[r] = [3] * cols
    return out
